en.answer: In the proposed scenario, since Special Summons cannot be performed as a result of the effect of <<9153>>, the part of the effect that destroys a card is performed but the part of the effect that Special Summons is not applied.
en.question: If <<9153>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<11993>> that Special Summons, how does the effect resolve?
en.title: If <<9153>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<11993>> that Special Summons, how does the effect resolve?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、「<<9153>>」の効果によって特殊召喚が行えなくなりますので、『そのカードを破壊し』の処理は適用されますが、『デッキから「ブンボーグ」モンスター１体を特殊召喚する』処理は適用されません。
